headlines.summary: 구윤철 부총리 "위기 대응은 타이밍, 석유 최고가격제 안착 및 전쟁추경 조속 마련" 재정경제부 제공 정부가 중동 사태 장기화에 따른 원자재 수급 불안을 해소하기 위해 나프타를 경제안보품목으로 지정하고, 피해 기업을 대상으로 1.5조원 규모의 긴급 금융지원에 나선다.

headlines.title: 정부, AI 제품 ·서비스 246개 상용화 에 7540억 원 내년까지 투입
headlines.summary: 1~2년 내 상용화 가능 제품 보유한 기업 대상 지원 정부가 내년까지 2년간 총 7540억원을 투입해 인공지능(AI) 제품·서비스 246개의 개발과 상용화를 지원한다. 기획예산처 등 관계부처는 18일 비상경제장관회의 겸 공급망안정위원회에서 이런 내용의 ‘AI 응용 제품 신속 상용화 지원 사업 추진 계획’을 밝혔다.

headlines.title: ‘ AI 전환 ’ 속도내는 정부 … 제품 상용화에 2년간 7540억

headlines.title: 할당관세 악용 차단, 석유화학 산업재편 지원 … 4월 시행 목표

headlines.title: “ 우리집도 종부세 내야 한대 ”… 경기남부도 ‘ 보유세 비상 ’ 현실화
headlines.summary: 국토부 ‘2026 공동주택 공시가격’ 발표 1년새 17만가구 급증…전국 50만가구 서울아파트 15%가 종부세 대상 ‘31.5만채’ 강남3구 공시가격 평균 24% 뛰어올라 현실화율 90% 로드맵 올 하반기 윤곽 18일 오전 매물표가 붙어 있는 서울 강남구 한 공인중개소 앞을 한 시민이 지나고 있다.

headlines.title: ' 주가누르기 방지법 ' 본격화... 전문가 들 "핵심은 상증세 개편"[ 주주 자본...
headlines.summary: 상법 개정 이어 상증세까지…지배구조 논의 확산 주주가치 제고 vs 승계 부담…"한국 구조적 딜레마" 세율 인하·제도 개편 놓고 전문가 의견 엇갈려 편집자주 개정 상법 시대를 맞아 한국 자본시장이 '주주자본주의'라는 새로운 전환점을 맞고 있다. 법 시행에 따른 제도적 변화는 기업 지배구조와 자본시장 관행 전반에 적지 않은 영향을 미칠 전망이다.

headlines.title: 시장금리 상승에 대출 이자부담 가중 … 주담대 상단 7% 눈앞
headlines.summary: 변동금리 기준 코픽스 한달만에 반등 “국고채 금리 상승 지속도 압력 작용” 은행권 주택담보대출(주담대) 변동금리의 산정 기준인 코픽스(COFIX·자금조달지수)가 한 달 만에 다시 오름세로 돌아섰다. 시장금리 상승세와 맞물려 주담대 금리 상단이 7%를 목전에 두면서 서민의 이자 부담은 더욱 무거워질 전망이다.

headlines.title: “ 부동산 대출규제 늦어도 4월 발표 ”
headlines.summary: 李대통령 대출정비 주문에 금융위 속도 다주택자 대출 연장 원칙적 금지 가닥 비거주 1주택, 예외 기준 설정이 관건 이재명 대통령이 부동산 문제 해결을 위한 금융정책 마련을 거듭 주문하면서 금융당국의 규제 설계에도 속도가 붙을 전망이다.

headlines.title: 고용률 역대 최고지만… 청년 층은 3년째 하락
headlines.summary: 지난해 제조·건설 부진에 청년고용 한파…20대 ‘쉬었음’ 40만8천명 14일 서울 마포구 서울서부고용복지플러스센터 모습. 연합뉴스 지난해 연간 고용률이 역대 최고치를 기록했지만, 고용 시장의 온기가 고루 퍼지지 못하는 모습이다. 주력 산업인 제조업·건설업의 부진이 지속되고, 고용 시장의 주축인 청년층 고용률은 3년 연속 하락세를 기록했다.

headlines.title: “ AI 신입에 밀렸어요 ”… 청년 실업률 7.7% ‘ 5년래 최고 ’
headlines.summary: ■ 데이터처 ‘2월 고용 동향’ 전체 취업자 23만명 늘었지만 청년은 14만명 넘게 줄어들어 전문과학·기술서비스 등 둔화 AI 도입, 노동 시장 영향 분석 60세이상 28만명 늘어 양극화 내 일자리는 어디에… 17일 대구 북구 엑스코에서 열린 2026원스톱기업지원박람회에서 한 구직자가 행사장에 마련된 참여기업 구인정보판을 살펴보고 있다.

headlines.title: 청년실업 5년새 최고치 …‘ 쉬었음 ’ 272만명
headlines.summary: 국가데이터처 2월 고용동향 발표 60대이상 중심 취업자 23.4만 증가 청년실업률 7.7%…전년비 0.7%P 늘어 청년 고용률, 22개월 연속 하락 부진 청년층 고용이 갈수록 악화되고 있다. 2월 청년층(15~29세) 실업률은 7.7%로 전년 동월보다 0.7%포인트 상승하며 코로나19 시기였던 2021년 2월(10.1%) 이후 5년 만에 최고치를 기록했다.

headlines.title: 2월 취업자 증가폭, 20만명대로 늘었는데 … 청년 실업률 5년 만 최고
headlines.summary: 데이터처, 2월 고용동향 발표 취업자 전년 대비 23.4만명 증가 고용률 61.8%…역대 최고치 반면 청년 실업률 7.7%…코로나 이후 최고 [세종=뉴시스] 강종민 기자 = 빈현준 국가데이터처 사회통계국장이 18일 세종시 정부세종청사에서 2026년 2월 고용동향을 발표하고 있다.

key_headlines.title: Government to Provide 1.5 Trillion Won Support for Supply Chain-Affected Businesses
key_headlines.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yoon-chul announced a 1.5 trillion won financial aid package for businesses impacted by supply chain disruptions, along with a temporary designation of Naphtha as an economic security item.

key_headlines.title: Naphtha Temporarily Designated Economic Security Item Amid Supply Shortages, Alternative Imports Sought
key_headlines.summary: With Naphtha supplies critical due to the Middle East situation impacting the Strait of Hormuz, the government will temporarily classify it as an economic security item and actively pursue alternative import channels.

key_headlines.title: Domestic Petrochemical Complexes Face 'Naphtha Shock,' Production Halts Expected in a Week
key_headlines.summary: The disruption of Naphtha supply from the Strait of Hormuz is creating a 'Naphtha shock' for Korean petrochemical complexes, with facilities like Yeochun NCC in Yeosu National Industrial Complex anticipating a full shutdown as early as March 24th.

key_headlines.title: Deputy PM Koo Yoon-chul Calls for Lower Gas Station Prices, Considers Car Rationing
key_headlines.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yoon-chul emphasized that gas station prices should decrease further and mentioned the government is considering additional demand management measures, such as car rationing, if supply shocks persist.

key_headlines.title: Naphtha Supply Crisis Prompts Urgent Call for Financial Support and Fair Practices
key_headlines.summary: The government is prioritizing comprehensive measures, including swift supplementary budgets for small business stability, strict enforcement against unfair petroleum product practices, and review of car rationing, all in response to the Naphtha supply crisis.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean government is urgently responding to a 'Naphtha shock' triggered by Middle East tensions, which threatens petrochemical production. Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yoon-chul announced 1.5 trillion won in financial support for affected businesses and the temporary designation of Naphtha as an economic security item. This classification aims to facilitate securing alternative import routes and stabilize supply. Concerns are rising about potential ripple effects, including a nationwide halt in petrochemical plant operations within a week and the consideration of demand-side measures like car rationing.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Iranian conflict is escalating global inflation concerns, with Australia recently raising its benchmark interest rate to 4.10% due to an overheating economy and inflation fears. For South Korea, the surge in Dubai oil prices is directly impacting import costs, given that 70% of its crude oil is sourced from the Middle East. Domestically, a planning agency warned that the national pension fund's depletion could lead to a significant fiscal deficit of 5.1% of GDP by 2065, underscoring the urgency of reform. Meanwhile, emerging economies heavily reliant on energy imports are facing severe oil shocks, which are projected to hinder GDP growth despite government fiscal interventions.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market saw a positive trend, with the KOSPI index recovering above 5,800 and KOSDAQ showing strength, largely driven by gains in semiconductor stocks, though investors remained cautious ahead of the FOMC meeting. In the fund market, Samsung Asset Management's KODEX Samsung Electronics Bond Mixed ETF surpassed 1 trillion won in net assets, while KOSDAQ active ETFs attracted 1.2 trillion won in just one week. A recent report indicated that roughly one in four Koreans are shareholders, with Samsung Electronics and EcoPro BM being the most popular stocks on the KOSPI and KOSDAQ, respectively. Furthermore, bond experts largely anticipate the Korean won to strengthen or remain stable, with a significant portion also expecting interest rates to either rise or hold steady.
sections.Industry & Technology: Korea is making strides in advanced technology, with the opening of a 'Global Healthcare Medical Engineering Research Institute' in Pohang dedicated to bio-semiconductor research. There is a strong focus on strategic international collaborations, with 'energy and nuclear power' identified as leading candidates for Korea's first major investment project in the United States. In the semiconductor sector, major players Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are competing to establish autonomous, unmanned factories by 2030, leveraging digital twin and humanoid robot technologies to enhance production efficiency. These developments are contributing to a positive sentiment around semiconductor stocks, with both companies seeing a resurgence in their share prices.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's housing market experienced a significant decline in purchase sentiment in February, marking the steepest drop among all provinces, contrasting sharply with the relatively stable sentiment for Jeonse (deposit-based lease) contracts. To address housing insecurity and prevent fraud, Seoul City is offering specialized, practical education on lease contract procedures for young residents. Despite a general slowdown in local real estate markets, apartments situated near national industrial complexes are performing well, benefiting from stable demand driven by large-scale employment and industrial bases. Overall, the outlook for housing developers worsened in March, primarily due to shrinking buyer sentiment and growing concerns over an increase in unsold properties.
sections.International Economy: The ongoing Iran conflict is a central concern for the global economy, heavily influencing the Federal Reserve's upcoming FOMC meeting, particularly regarding oil prices and long-term inflation. Investors are closely watching the Fed's 'dot plot' and Chairman Powell's remarks for clues on future interest rate directions amidst high oil price volatility. Furthermore, there are reports that the US, under President Trump, is considering imposing tariffs or leveraging security cooperation against allies, including South Korea, who declined to send troops to the Strait of Hormuz, highlighting potential shifts in international trade and security relationships.
sections.AI & Economy: Artificial intelligence is rapidly becoming a key economic driver in Korea. Doosan Tesna is experiencing strong growth, fueled by increasing demand for AI-related technologies. The Korean government plans to invest 754 billion won by next year to accelerate the commercialization of AI application products, aiming to integrate AI into daily life and various industries. Regionally, Chungnam Province is embarking on an ambitious 'AI Grand Transformation' strategy, committing 5.89 trillion won by 2035 to reshape its entire industrial structure with AI. Additionally, AI startups like Upstage are exploring strategic partnerships with investors such as AMD to strengthen GPU-based AI alliances, while Moa Life Plus is expanding into digital new businesses by incorporating AI, data, and FinTech into its healthcare and commerce platforms.
sections.Others: Paju City has allocated 26.9 billion won in local currency to support livelihoods and announced a 2.4 trillion won supplementary budget focused on building future infrastructure. E-commerce giant Coupang is partnering with Nvidia to establish 'AI Factories,' aiming to maximize the efficiency of its 'Rocket Delivery' logistics through real-time AI control of the entire supply chain. Meanwhile, the crude oil crisis alert has been elevated to 'Caution,' and Naphtha has been officially designated as an economic security item due to severe supply concerns related to the Strait of Hormuz. In political news, Park Su-min of the People Power Party has announced his candidacy for Seoul Mayor. On the sports front, undefeated champion Khamzat Chimaev is slated to challenge former champion Sean Strickland for the middleweight title in May.
